Usage: dotnet efstudio [options]

Options:
  --project <path>           Target project that contains the DbContext types.
  --startup-project <path>   Startup project used to build the service provider.
  --context <name>           DbContext name to preselect.
  --port <port>              Local port for the EFStudio server.
  --no-browser               Do not open the browser automatically.
  --help                     Show command help.
